name: Jozabad
overview: Jozabad was a male descendant of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the Gederathite. He is noted for coming to David at Ziklag, indicating his allegiance during a significant period in Israel's history. His tribal affiliation and unique designation highlight his role among those who supported David.
namesAndTitles: The name Jozabad means 'YHWH bestowed,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning tied to God's provision. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 12:4 and underscores a divine aspect associated with his identity.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jozabad as a descendant of Benjamin, but no other family relationships or surnames are documented. Beyond his tribal lineage, further family details are not provided.
scriptureSignificance: Jozabad's significance lies in his loyalty to David, as evidenced by his coming to David at Ziklag. His identification as a Gederathite of Benjamin situates him within the broader narrative of David's consolidation of support from various tribes. This demonstrates the gathering of faithful followers around David, which was crucial for the establishment of his kingship.
